case.summary: Transaction 3640919 for $881.55 on card C09241-K2 was flagged solely by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.71. The bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model evaluated the transaction at 0.003 with a historical fraud rate of only 0.63%. The in-person transaction occurred in region 494, where the cardholder possesses an established baseline of 491 prior transactions, and the holder has zero confirmed fraud history. Furthermore, the card does not belong to any active fraud ring, and all comparable historical closed cases were cleared as legitimate. The activity is determined to be legitimate cardholder spending and the case is closed with no fraud.
